reasoning: All three claimed omissions are real, and there is a fourth, worse one. (1) pack_exchange_kokkos (fix_wall_gran_kokkos.cpp:386-411) syncs 'k_history_one.template sync<DeviceType>()' and then runs a kernel that writes d_history_one for the copylist compaction (:377-379), but never calls modify<DeviceType>(); fix_spring_self_kokkos.cpp:239 and fix_neigh_history_kokkos.cpp:443-445 both do. It also never calls 'k_buf.modify<DeviceType>()' + sync to the requested space, which fix_spring_self_kokkos.cpp:235-238 does. (2) unpack_exchange_kokkos (:431-450) writes the device view and calls modify<DeviceType>() at :449 with no preceding sync<DeviceType>() -- compare fix_spring_self_kokkos.cpp:285. It also omits 'k_buf.sync<DeviceType>()'/'k_indices.sync<DeviceType>()' (fix_spring_self_kokkos.cpp:274-275). (3) unpack_exchange (:353-361) calls the base (which writes history_one on the host) and then modify_host() without a sync_host(); its own pack_exchange at :346 and fix_neigh_history_kokkos.cpp:515-517 do sync first. (4) NOT IN THE FINDING but more consequential: post_force (:70-124) writes d_history_one in the kernel every timestep and never calls k_history_one.modify<DeviceType>() either -- nothing in the file marks the shear history device-modified except unpack_exchange_kokkos:449. So on a GPU build the DualView believes host and device are in sync while the host copy is stale from the first timestep on, and any host-side path that then calls modify_host (copy_arrays during delete_atoms, unpack_exchange) makes that stale copy authoritative and the accumulated shear history is silently discarded.
fix: Add 'k_history_one.template modify<DeviceType>();' at the end of post_force (after the parallel_for) and at the end of pack_exchange_kokkos; add 'k_history_one.template sync<DeviceType>();' before the parallel_for in unpack_exchange_kokkos, together with 'k_buf.sync<DeviceType>(); k_indices.sync<DeviceType>();'; add 'k_buf.modify<DeviceType>();' plus the 'if (space == Host) k_buf.sync_host(); else k_buf.sync_device();' pair at the end of pack_exchange_kokkos; and add 'k_history_one.sync_host();' at the start of unpack_exchange.
